name: 集团报表 – 财务合并 (1SG)
description_en_html:
Overview

In SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, this scope item provides customers with statutory financial consolidation capabilities. Features of this scope item include data integration with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition, avoids replication (using the main actual table as a data source), flexible upload capability to collect financial data from non-SAP S/4HANA subsidiaries, product validations to ensure data integrity, consolidation methods to produce statutory consolidation, and key audit reports and consolidated financial statements including Profit and Loss and Balance Sheet reports.

This scope item also provides two optional scenarios. You can choose whether to perform them or not according to your own needs:

  • Matrix Consolidation

    Matrix consolidation covers consolidation for management-oriented organizational units such as profit center and business segment. This functionality addresses the needs of business unit managers and group controllers who need to respond rapidly to changes resulting from internal organization unit restructuring and who need to focus on specific internal performance figures and not the entire group financial statement.

    Matrix consolidation introduces new reporting dimensions that are derived at report run-time and not persisted in the universal journal. These virtual organizational units allow the reporting user to show inter-unit eliminations at the correct hierarchy level.

  • Consolidation with Multiple Group Currencies and Restatement Versions

    We provide the following major scenarios of version concept: group currency extension versions, restatements, and simulations.

    Group currency extension versions allow you to consolidate in different group currencies.

    Restatement versions can be used when new accounting standards are adopted or management organizations are changed. By restating the prior periods, you can compare financial data between prior and current periods.

    Simulation versions are used when you need to consolidate the current period using different settings (for example, group structure, cons methods).

    Note:

    The version configuration in this document is only for testing purposes only. In your projects, design your version stack based on your own version settings and requirements.

Key Process Flow

  • Prepare data (financial statement item preparation, update for group transactions types)
  • Load data from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and outside sources
  • Validate data with sets of built-in controls
  • Consolidate data
  • Perform reporting and auditing

Business Benefits

  • Integrate fully with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition
  • Provide flexible upload for non-SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition companies
  • Validate product to ensure data integrity (built-in)
  • Produce statutory financial consolidation with powerful calculation engine
  • View reporting using the SAP Fiori launchpad
description_zh_html:
概览

在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中，此范围项目为客户提供法定财务合并功能。此范围项目的功能包括与 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 的数据集成、避免复制（使用主要实际表作为数据源）、灵活上载功能以从非 SAP S/4HANA 子公司收集财务数据、确保数据完整性的产品验证、用于生成法定合并的合并方法以及关键审计报表和合并财务报表，包括损益表和资产负债表。

此范围项目还提供两个可选场景。您可以根据自己的需求选择是否执行这些任务：

  • 矩阵合并

    矩阵合并涵盖面向管理的组织单位（如利润中心和业务段）的合并。此功能可满足业务单元经理和集团控制人员的需求，这些经理和集团控制员需要快速响应内部组织单位重组带来的变化，并且需要关注特定的内部绩效指标，而不是整个集团财务报表。

    矩阵合并引入了新的报表维度，这些维度在报表运行时派生且不会保留在通用日记账中。这些虚拟组织单位允许报告用户在正确的层次结构级别显示单位间抵销。

  • 使用多种集团货币的合并和重申版本

    我们提供以下版本概念的主要场景：集团货币扩展版本、重申和模拟。

    集团货币扩展版本允许您以不同集团货币进行合并。

    采用新的会计标准或更改管理组织时，可以使用重申版本。通过重申先前期间，您可以比较先前期间和当前期间之间的财务数据。

    当您需要使用不同的设置（例如，组结构、合并方法）合并当前期间时，将使用模拟版本。

    注释：

    本文档中的版本配置仅用于测试目的。在您的项目中，根据您自己的版本设置和要求设计版本堆栈。

关键流程流

  • 准备数据（财务报表项目准备、组交易类型的更新）
  • 从 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 和外部源加载数据
  • 使用一系列内置控件验证数据
  • 合并数据
  • 执行报告和审计

业务优势

  • 与 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 完全集成
  • 为非 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 公司提供灵活上传
  • 验证产品以确保数据完整性（内置）
  • 使用强大的计算引擎生成法定财务合并
  • 使用 SAP Fiori 快速启动板查看报表
